records.text: Who is this guy? Where is his money coming from? Tucker (Tucker Carlson) will later say he doesn't know what came over him. He just—just this is just how he felt, and Charlie (Charlie Kirk) said go after the Epstein (Jeffrey Epstein) stuff. On July 11th, Frank Turek deletes his website, frankturek.com. The website has remnants of an expedition he took. I went on Wayback Machine. He was looking for remnants of Noah's Ark. I don't know what that means, but just found that to be interesting that he deletes his website. On July 12th
records.speaker: Candace Owens
